title: Vietnamese Com Tam
description: Com Tam is a comforting Vietnamese comfort food featuring a rich, deeply flavored broth, topped with crispy, char-grilled rice and various toppings. This version is a unique take on the traditional dish, featuring the subtle sweetness of vanilla and the earthy flavor of binchotan charcoal.
instructions: Combine 4 cups of water and 2 tablespoons of binchotan charcoal in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Add 2 tablespoons of sesame oil, 2 sliced inches of ginger, and 2 cloves of minced garlic to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of cooked rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add 2 tablespoons of vanilla bean seeds and stir to combine.
Add 2 tablespoons of fish sauce, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 2 tablespoons of lime juice, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Heat a small skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 cup of chopped scallions and cook, stirring frequently, until crispy and golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
To serve, place a scoop of the rice mixture into a bowl and top with crispy scallions and any desired toppings.
